label: Garden 3D Kit
description: One node for Olive’s Island (the bot-garden template): Garden 3D, the same ports as Garden Kit’s Garden (Map, Things, Robots, Bubble, Step Ms, Celebrate, Label; Tile X, Tile Y, Tile Tapped, Ready) drawn as a little flat-shaded island in three.js — tile boxes with a height per kind, cone-on-cylinder trees, icosahedron rocks, a box-and-prism house, stem-and-bulb tulips, robots as a box body with a visor, eyes and a hat — that pans with one finger, zooms with a pinch or a wheel, and reports the tapped tile. Plus Camera (plot, island, follow), Focus, Frame Ms (a rolling p95) and Supported (WebGL2 present), so a page can fall back to the flat Garden. three.js 0.158.0 is vendored beside the node (MIT). The kit draws; the engine decides.
